about: Wording bank for the voxel suite (beebot.vla.voxel.wordings reads it): paraphrase templates per intent, a slot lexicon from canonical values to open expressions, and categories that denote sets of colours. Every list has a training part and a held-out part that is never used in training. Written by hand (Claude, 2026-11-10); see 'rulings' for the borderline words.

rulings.lime: in, for green, but only as 'lime green' (training): bare lime is yellowish and also a fruit and a mineral
rulings.olive: out: olive is a dull yellow-brown green and olives are also black
rulings.plum: out: between purple and dark red, and plums come in red and yellow
rulings.amber: out: sits between yellow and orange, both of which are canonical colours here
rulings.teal: out: a dark blue-green that people place under green, blue or cyan
rulings.turquoise, aqua: in, for cyan: aqua is the web name of cyan itself and turquoise is the everyday word for that hue
rulings.indigo, magenta, fuchsia: out: indigo is blue or purple, magenta and fuchsia are pink or purple
rulings.gold, golden, mustard: out: between yellow and orange, or brownish
rulings.cream, pearl: out: cream is yellowish and pearl is iridescent
rulings.salmon, coral, peach, rust: out: between orange and pink, or brownish
rulings.burgundy, maroon: out: purplish or brownish dark reds
rulings.grape, beetroot, blackcurrant: out: grapes are also green, beetroot is red-purple, blackcurrant nearly black
rulings.sun, egg yolk, fox, tiger: out: the sun is drawn yellow but is also called orange or white; yolks are yellow to orange; foxes are reddish; tigers are striped
rulings.sky, ocean, sea: in, for blue, by convention; cyan gets no object descriptions because every candidate (pool water, lagoon, glacier) can also be read as blue
rulings.rose: out: roses are red in the saying but the colour word rose means pink
rulings.mint, pine, moss: out as bare adjectives (flavour, tree, plant first); not needed
rulings.cherry, lemon, tangerine, lavender: in: used in a colour frame ('cherry-coloured') or, for tangerine and lavender, as established colour adjectives
rulings.top, bottom, upper, lower (regions): out: in a 3D world they read as height, not as back and front
rulings.compass words (regions): in, held out: north is the back of the floor (row 0 of a map with the back at the top), west is left
rulings.a few, several, a handful, a couple (cou: out: no definite value, or below the smallest tower
rulings.sums (counts): in, held out: 'two plus two', 'half of ten' have one value and use no trained number word
rulings.donut, torus (ring): out: a torus is thick; the ring is one voxel thin
rulings.box (cube): held out only as 'box that is empty inside'; a bare box is not hollow
rulings.far corner on the left: out: cannot be followed by 'of the floor'; 'far left corner' says the same
